config.notes: ANU Programs and Courses pages (programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/program/<CODE>, undated URL = next academic year; /<YEAR>/program/<CODE> = archived year): no page data. International annual fee after "Annual indicative fee for international students" (5+ digits; for programs under 48 units ANU prints the fee for the shorter program). Length after "Length", mode after "Mode of delivery". Start dates and English (IELTS) are not on these pages: English is set centrally by ANU English Language Admission Requirements; start dates are central (Semester 1 Feb, Semester 2 July) with program-specific notes only in free text.
